title: Ravnai

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.38b.3), speaking in the name of Abaye; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim cites a reading that it should be Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Ravnai speaking in Abaye’s name about the blessing over cooked vegetables. [Heilprin’s Ravnai entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3219&lang=en) records the same chain. Hyman reports the Rava reading from Dikdukei Soferim.
